steps.en: Officer finds the affected notice in the staff portal
steps.id: Officer mencari notice terdampak di staff portal
steps.why_en: Normal notice search works, but no court application details can be shown for the notice.
steps.why_id: Pencarian notice biasa jalan, tetapi detail permohonan court tidak bisa ditampilkan.

steps.en: Officer sets the court application indicator to Rejected
steps.id: Officer mengubah indikator permohonan court menjadi Rejected
steps.why_en: There is no screen or field to mark an application as rejected.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada layar atau kolom untuk menandai permohonan sebagai ditolak.

steps.en: Processing stage of affected notices is reverted
steps.why_en: No logic exists to step a notice back after a rejection.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada logika untuk memundurkan stage notice setelah penolakan.

steps.en: Court application batch number is cleared from the notices
steps.id: Nomor batch permohonan court dikosongkan dari notice
steps.why_en: Notices carry no court application batch number in the system, so nothing can be cleared.
steps.why_id: Notice tidak punya nomor batch permohonan court di sistem, jadi tidak ada yang bisa dikosongkan.
